name: Draft-Kiln Post
core_rationale: Central kiln-mason outpost town of Ash-Bellows Trench at [1, 1] built around Sola's acoustic draft-wheel where masons tune the basin's airflow and guard the Ember-Bellows Chamber.

terrain_tile.water_feature: Warm celadon glaze-settling pools ringing the central acoustic draft-wheel

North.lock_message: Molten celadon glaze-vapor vents through the northern Glaze Flue; the Draft-Kiln Masons require the Bellows Counterweight Key before unbolting the northern louver.

resident_npcs.name: Draft-Mason Toma
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Listen to the three-note hum of our ceramic draft-wheel, young Sprout! Every cottage hearth in Hearthbloom Basin breathes through these tunnels.

resident_npcs.name: Glaze-Tuner Pell
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Down in the Ember-Bellows Chamber, a vitrified slag-guardian swallowed the Bellows Counterweight Key. Bring it back so we can open the northern Glaze Flue!

causal_continuity.evidence: Anchors Ash-Bellows Trench at [1, 1] directly above Sola's Ember-Bellows Chamber.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: A warm ceramic kiln-mason town centered on a singing three-note acoustic draft-wheel.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Counters at 0.58m, brick stair risers at 0.14m, doorways 2.10m x 1.55m, and 13.0m walkways for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Symmetric West portal to hunting-area-firebrick-duct, Dungeon portal to dungeon-ember-bellows-chamber, and North fog_of_lore portal to hunting-area-glaze-flue-vent.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Seals the northern Glaze Flue Vent behind a fog_of_lore boundary portal and Draft-Kiln Masons lock message.
